modifiedSubsystems.nature: Added. Universe multichain explorer, protocol directory, chain dashboard, mining, charts and documentation surfaces. No upstream file is involved.
Universe lazy routes added; upstream routes untouched.
The asset flow section is embedded on the transaction page.
Unit test runner added. Upstream ships no working test target.
MEMPOOL.HTTP_HOST added, defaulting to loopback. Upstream binds every interface.
Publishes the node's own sync state so the explorer can say when its data is behind the chain.
Hosted analytics reduced to a no-op; the upstream subdomain redirect removed.
Added. Gateway, release manifest, visual QA harness, protocol coverage generator and their gates.
Mempool Holdings trademarks replaced across templates, SEO and the web manifest. See docs/legal/TRADEMARK-AUDIT.md.
Pinned to the Universe toolchain version (24.19.0).

knownUpstreamConflicts.nature: Both sides add routes to the same table. Every upstream sync has to merge route lists rather than take a side.
Upstream dependency bumps land beside the Universe test runner and chart dependencies.
The loopback default sits in a file upstream edits routinely.
